title: Ghamon ki inteha
body:
zabeehe maariya hussain
qateele nainawaz hussain
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ki laash laate hai lehad koi banate hai
watan se door dasht may hussain gham uthaate hai
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai be-khata mera pisar koi bachaye aan kar
sadayein de rahi ye tadap tadap ke nauhagar
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
na to kafan naseeb hai na to watan naseeb hai
nabi ka laadla hussain is khadar ghareeb hai
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghamon se choor choor hai lahoo lahoo hai shaahe deen
magar hai sajda e khuda may kham hussain ki jabeen
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
sina ki nok par azan naye jahad ka imtehan
sina pe aage aage hai hussain meer e karwan
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ghurbat e shahe zaman naseeb kab hua kafan
ye inteha e zulm thi juda juda kiya badan
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
laraz rahi thi khud zameen falak pe hashr tha bapa
churi hai kund aur gardan e ghareeb e fatema
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan sitam ka silsila kahan ghareeb e nainawa
ye kehke dayam aur yazdan ro padi wo ghamzada
ghamon ki inteha hussain
hussain hussain hussain...
author: Dayam Najafi
